title: X-Files Theme
blurb: Mark Snow's whistling X-Files theme was reportedly discovered by accident, when his elbow landed on a keyboard preset and triggered an echo effect he decided to keep — one of television's great happy mistakes. A handful of notes and everyone in the room instantly knows what you are implying: that something here is deeply suspicious and possibly extraterrestrial. It is the definitive conspiracy cue, used to punctuate everything from unexplained noises upstairs to a colleague's third dentist appointment this month.
origin: Mark Snow's title theme for The X-Files (1993).
